For n>=9 the bounded exceptional loci leave a generic y; root profiles depend only on divisibility by 2,3,4,8, with the n=7 boundary explicitly handled. Small n3..24 are finite exact atomic calculations. Gomaa 2007 Lemma 3.10 identifies rank-l dihedral and cyclic equivalence, not merely a heuristic. Independently computed entire cyclic root extension types (actual atomic multiplication/equality diagrams, not the eight-test compression) for n3..109, exactly 13 classes with representatives 3,4,5,6,7,8,9,10,12,16,18,20,24 and correct gcd24 memberships. Infinite claim rests on symbolic case split plus transfer, not finite enumeration.
